disks.title: xcpmz80 for Compucorp 665 (Standard)
disks.description: Open-source CP/M-compatible OS for the Compucorp 665 with FAT12 disks, 4 KB track buffer, 34 KB TPA, and utilities (TIME, FORMAT, SYS, DSKTEST, RAMDRV). Automatically enables PB5 ROM-off mod and xcpmz80 keyboard layout.

disks.title: xcpmz80 for Compucorp 665 (36K TPA)
disks.description: Compact 3-sector buffer build of xcpmz80 providing 36 KB TPA for larger CP/M programs. Automatically enables PB5 ROM-off mod and xcpmz80 keyboard layout.

disks.title: xcpmz80 for Compucorp 665 (60 Hz 24x10)
disks.description: xcpmz80 build configured for 60 Hz 10-scanline CRT timing (24 rows x 10 scanlines). Automatically enables PB5 ROM-off mod and xcpmz80 keyboard layout.

disks.title: Omega Document Disk (DOCS)
disks.description: Prepared empty Omega document disk (150 free pages) ready for saving and recalling documents in Drive B:.

disks.title: Blank Formatted Disk
disks.description: Low-level formatted disk (data only on track 0). Use Omega COMMAND P D to prepare it as a document disk.

disks.title: Compucorp 665 Hardware Diagnostics
disks.description: Standalone bare-metal hardware diagnostic suite testing RAM, paged memory boards, video, keyboard, CTC/mains, floppy, and SIO B.

disks.title: ROM-Switch Hardware Probe
disks.description: Tests candidate output ports (port 74h, PIO B spare pins, SIO B lines) to see if any unmap the boot ROM. Enable PB5 or port 74h ROM-off in Settings to test.
